liquidityModel: Plain exit pays idle first, then configured liquidity adapter. ForceDeallocate is separate and can charge a penalty; it must not be treated as free immediate liquidity.
supportedLiquidity: Actual gate-checked idle, capped to owner assets. Additional allocated liquidity and force-deallocation penalties are excluded. This is a conservative immediate lower bound, not a claim that every possible V2 adapter family is modeled.
configuration: PARAM_ROLE must set a deployed MorphoVaultV2LiquidityView. V2 deposits without a view are rejected atomically; helper deployment and config must be included in preflight/typed manifests.
